About Me

Movement has always been my passion — in every form. For over five years I've been a karate instructor, sharing knowledge and discipline with students of all ages. As a camp counselor at sports camps, I worked with diverse groups, learning precise task communication and ensuring everyone understood the goal.

I apply the same principles to programming: precision, clear communication, and strong technical leadership. I believe a good application solves a real problem — not a list of technologies, but measurable impact.

After hours I continue growing: experimenting with new technologies, building open source projects, and learning new architectural patterns. Karate taught me patience and systematicity — the same traits help me write clean, maintainable code.
